items.summary: arXiv:2608.00410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. items.summary: arXiv:2608.01175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning but benefit from grounding provided by Knowledge Graphs (KGs). items.title: Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races
items.summary: arXiv:2608.01193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation.
